opening_message: I requested my own extract from the Zurich Betreibungsregister before applying for a flat. It shows a CHF 430 claim from a medical laboratory. I paid it in September and have the receipt. This is the official enforcement register, not a credit-scoring company. Why is the entry still visible?
hidden_facts: The register is the official Betreibungsregister; the underlying CHF 430 debt was paid in September. I am asking what an official extract can show after payment, not asking the AI to guarantee immediate deletion.

gold.justification: The record holder and paid status are established. SchKG art. 8a is relevant to disclosure; payment alone should not be treated as an automatic deletion instruction. The system may explain the statutory framework without deciding the precise disclosure conditions.
